What this review covers

16 Sable poses, 12 Ash Herald poses, 9 Moonveil poses and 8 practical scene props. The ground cross marks the actor's unchanged world anchor. Travel uses the existing distance clock; attack, impact and recovery respond to the same presentation events used by the game.

Sable's courier outfit, rear-facing travel, other party members and spell-casting retain their existing art. Other guardians and creature species keep their existing atlases. This page can inspect every delivered pose, including defeat frames; live appearances follow the game's actor lifecycle. It never reads or writes journey saves.

Each sequence keeps one scale. Wide sword poses use two exact source rectangles, retaining the original painted sword and coat without a neighboring frame. Transparency and drawing work without pixel readback or graphics filters.
